messages:
marcel: quick heads-up — Datadog asked for a concise smoke-test + GovCloud ops checklist before we publish the marketplace tile. They specifically want: cert rotation steps, data residency notes, sanitized dashboard JSON, and a short runbook for smoke testing ingestion. Can eng + legal + security confirm?

erin: marketing: we need three screenshotable dashboard snapshots (US, EU, GovCloud) and a 1-paragraph blurb for the tile. Keep copy vendor-neutral, highlight low-latency inference metrics.

rishi: runtime: noted. tech bullets from my side: 1) OTLP -> Datadog exporter supports site selection (datadoghq.com / datadoghq.eu / dd-gov.datadoghq) 2) per-tenant API keys (KMS) 3) exporter-level sanitization (drop emails/request bodies) 4) recommend default marketplace ingest cap (1000 reqs/min unless customer raises limit).

claire: sre: add operational guidance: if you have model fan-out (multiple replicas per request) add redwood.request.id on the root span so Datadog can collapse duplicates. Also recommend tail-sampling for traces >2s to control cost.

tam: legal: we can provide the checklist and a DPA summary but no contract language. For GovCloud, confirm that logs/traces are routed to GovCloud endpoints only. Also: "no customer PII in public screenshots" must be checked before publishing.

vlad: security: require per-tenant keys in KMS + audit logging for key access. Recommend weekly key rotation for marketplace tiles and enforce mTLS to Datadog intake endpoints. I'll add a short note about re-identification risks when hashing user ids.

datadog-bot: integration: please upload a sample dashboard JSON and the minimal OTLP exporter snippet. We'll run a quick ingest smoke test on our side once you push staging traffic.

rishi: quick OTLP exporter snippet we can show in docs (YAML):
```yaml
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: ${DD_API_KEY}    # per-tenant, store in KMS
    site: datadoghq.eu       # choose per-region: datadoghq.com / datadoghq.eu / dd-gov.datadoghq
processors:
  redact:
    rules:
      - key: user.email
        action: remove
      - key: request.body
        action: remove
  batch: {}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [redact, batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

claire: sample dashboard JSON (anonymized ids) — marketing can screenshot these: 
{"widgets":[{"title":"latency p50/p95","metric":"redwood.request.latency_p95","display":"p50_p95"},{"title":"tokens/sec","metric":"redwood.token.count","display":"rate"},{"title":"model fallback %","metric":"redwood.model.fallback_rate","display":"percent"}]}

marcel: nice. next steps so we have owners: 1) Rishi 1 produce sanitized OTLP snippet + staging exporter (ETA: Tue) 2) Claire 1 dashboard JSON + screenshot exports (ETA: Wed) 3) Tam 1 DPA/GovCloud checklist copy (ETA: Wed) 4) Vlad 1 ops-security notes (KMS rotation + mTLS) (ETA: Thu) 5) Erin 1 marketing tile copy + webinar invite draft (ETA: Fri).

rishi: created branch redwood/datadog-smoke, pushing exporter sanitizer and a small test fixture.

datadog-bot: smoke-test: ingestion job queued for partner=redwood, env=staging.

datadog-bot: smoke-test: ingestion succeeded (2026-03-20T18:07:12Z) — 1200 traces accepted, 0 rejects.

vlad: quick security caveat: when hashing user IDs, call out that deterministic hashing + other metadata could enable re-id; prefer keyed HMAC if we want stronger protection. I'll add a one-paragraph note to the ops doc.

tam: adding legal checklist item: "Confirm GovCloud routing and data residency; verify screenshots contain no customer identifiers; include link to DPA summary."

erin: once we have the three screenshots and the blurb I'll loop in Datadog for a short co-marketing review. prefer we schedule a 30m sync rather than a big webinar for this initial marketplace launch.

marcel: sweet. If anyone adds changes to the PR or dashboard, ping this thread. We'll hand this package to datadog-partners@ once legal signs off. :thumbsup:
